meta.name: Kamini
meta.description: Men in a village are disappearing in the darkness of the night. Is it the work of a mystical enchantress, or is there some other mystery?

videos.title: Defective Agency
videos.overview: The detective agency run by Samya and Arnab hasn't received a case in a long time. How will a new client change their lives?

videos.title: Birjopaat
videos.overview: Samya and Arnab come across the legend of Kamini upon reaching the village of Nishutipur. Is she just a myth, or is there a deeper mystery?

videos.title: Bijli
videos.overview: When the station master goes missing, Samya and Arnab visit the village head. Will he be able to make them believe in the legend of Kamini?

videos.title: Kamini Dur Hato
videos.overview: The villagers want to pray to gods to protect men from Kamini. Meanwhile, what danger awaits Samya and Arnab?

videos.title: Chunomacch
videos.overview: While the entire village stays up at night with the meditating priest, another man disappears. Whom do Samya and Arnab suspect?

videos.title: Rajababu
videos.overview: Samya and Arnab, start their journey towards the village palace with Bijli. What truth does the watchman reveal to them about the king?

videos.title: Rajbarir Ondore
videos.overview: The solutions to all the riddles around Kamini are spread inside the palace. Will Samya and Arnab finally know if Kamini's story is real?

videos.title: Tumi Kaamer Phaade Porecho
videos.overview: What is the real reason behind the disappearance of the men? Will Samya and Arnab be able to stop Kamini, or will they fall in her trap themselves?
